note: Owner-approved location corrections (13 Nov 2026). GEM point kept in gem_point.

gem:L100000601853.method: Coordinate from Wikipedia 'Dibang Dam' (secondary); confirmed by Sentinel-2 scene S2C_T46RGS_20261108T042411_L2A showing dam construction at a river confluence, matching NHPC's site description (Munli, ~1.5 km upstream of Ashu Pani-Dibang confluence)
gem:L100000601853.approved: owner 2026-11-13 (pictures and location); precision kept at site until an official coordinate is found
gem:L100000601853.precision_meaning: site identity confirmed on satellite imagery; coordinate not from an official document

discrepancy.gem_point: GEM marks its point approximate; it lies in the Siang basin west of the Dibang valley, not on the Dibang river
discrepancy.official_bounds: NHPC environmental compliance reports give the project area as 28d11m50s-29d25m59s N, 95d14m47s-95d36m49s E; the new point is inside the latitude range but ~16 km east of the stated eastern limit. NHPC fact sheet gives 96d36m49s as the eastern limit (one of the two is a typo), so the official bounds are inconsistent and not used as a coordinate
discrepancy.resolution: NHPC describes the dam at Munli, ~1.5 km upstream of the Ashu Pani-Dibang confluence, ~43 km by road from Roing. Sentinel-2 (8 Nov 2026) at the new point shows a large active dam construction site immediately upstream of a river confluence in the gorge; no other construction of that scale is visible. Straight-line distance to Roing (28.14 N, 95.84 E) is ~23 km, consistent with 43 km by road. GEM point rejected; new point accepted as site-confirmed, not exact.
